cues: A spinning body has energy, even though it is not going anywhere.
Think of the body as a crowd of tiny particles, masses m one, m two, m three, at distances r one, r two, r three from the axis.
text: A spinning body has energy, even though it is not going anywhere. Where is that energy? Think of the body as a crowd of tiny particles, masses m one, m two, m three, at distances r one, r two, r three from the axis.
